pitfalls.problem: write_file and checkpoint returned 'Task assignment changed; refresh context before mutation' because the write used the pre-refresh blob SHA during an assignment revision.
pitfalls.failed_approach: Issuing a mutation in the same turn the assignment sha changed, using the older PROGRESS.json SHA.
pitfalls.lesson: After an assignment sha change, re-read the target blob on the live branch; the guard rejection is a repair instruction, not proof of a failed edit. A later read showed the refreshed blob already landed at 19a64f70.

pitfalls.problem: PROGRESS.json on venice/repo-hierarchical-audit-v2 described the superseded v1 task.
pitfalls.failed_approach: Reusing the previous audit's PROGRESS.json as current assignment state.
pitfalls.lesson: Rewrite PROGRESS.json for the active task id with its live blob SHA as expected_sha; confirm the new blob on the next read.

pitfalls.problem: Workflow branch filter and source-matched test referenced the v1 branch, so no green run existed on the active v2 branch.
pitfalls.failed_approach: Assuming flipping the workflow filter alone would green the suite.
pitfalls.lesson: Workflow branches filter + checkout ref AND tests/test_repo_requirements_audit.py must all reference venice/repo-hierarchical-audit-v2, and a green run on the active head is required to close it.

pitfalls.problem: build_hierarchy.py raised SystemExit on requirement R8.1 because STAGES lacked S8 and SUBSTAGES lacked the '8 Shadow and live'/OPS entry.
pitfalls.failed_approach: Assuming the v2 mapping covered all canonical rows; only R0.1-R6.2 had been verified.
pitfalls.lesson: Add S8 plus an S8.1 substage keyed on gantt_group '8 Shadow and live'/lane OPS, handle the v1 'CLOSED' status explicitly, and verify build_matrices completes with no unmapped-requirement message.

pitfalls.problem: docs/venice-audit-v1/__pycache__ was tracked by the workflow commit step.
pitfalls.failed_approach: Plain git add without clearing cached bytecode.
pitfalls.lesson: Add git rm -r --cached docs/venice-audit-v1/__pycache__ before git add in the workflow commit step.
